ipp_framework.binding: go.mod dependency of the image-bound IPP source

artifact_gaps: No independently usable, approved metering backend image is established. See backend-decision.json; the shipped plugin is an integration client, not a billing server.
Bind a future Loki installation to the saved candidate and validate the served CRD after install; current Loki schema evidence is image-bound source, not an installed CRD.
qualification_gaps: Provision object storage and confirm retention, durable export and recovery; 30-day showback retention is not quarterly evidence retention.
Prove user self-only and administrator fleet access, trusted header provenance and actual user/subscription/model fields.
Prove token categories and streaming final usage, duplicate delivery, replay, outage loss and backend reconciliation; failed usage posts are logged, not a demonstrated durable delivery queue.
Prove balance overshoot/concurrency and deliberate fail-open/fail-closed behavior; a pre-request balance check is not an exact monetary reservation.
Establish a request/task correlation field. The pinned CloudEvent id is a new UUID and contains no gateway request id.
Qualify Loki export coverage and structured metadata. Zero fallbacks, async delivery loss and lack of a stable request identifier prevent claiming complete quarterly billing from native logs alone.

Prove the selected streaming-plugin profile against local and external OpenAI-compatible responses, one usage event per completed request, and a controlled reload. Provider response translation cannot be mixed with this chunk response plugin.
verification_scope: RHOAI MaaS/controller, payload processor and AI Gateway operator image identities match installed 3.5.1; Loki6.6.1 is an observed catalog candidate, not installed. No backend image verified and no usage logging or metering runtime qualification.
resolved_contracts: Config/default.spec.usageLogging is an enable switch in shipped3.5.1: true creates collector/proxy/RBAC/dashboards/EnvoyFilter; false removes owned logging resources. No setting is applied by this demo renderer.
Installed MaasTenantConfig telemetry has metrics.captureUser only and no logs.captureUser. The shipped EnvoyFilter always emits identity fields; no tenant logging patch is proposed.
The shipped pipeline expects LokiStack usage in the monitoring namespace, with openshift-logging tenant application; it does not require a DSCI logging field.
Loki Operator stable-6.6 offers6.6.1 and supports OCP4.22. Its image-bound source schema requires storageClassName; gp3-csi and explicit30-day retention are candidate inputs.

The per-user datasource uses TokenReview and namespace/user_id query filtering. The administrator datasource goes directly to the Loki application endpoint; authorization remains a runtime acceptance check.

The Envoy logging filter records POST /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions only. Token fields are structured metadata, with zero fallbacks on absent or unparseable usage; they cannot prove complete billing data alone.

The shipped controller intentionally preserves an existing plugins ConfigMap annotated opendatahub.io/managed=false. This supplies a persistent customization route; source annotations must not disable bootstrap. The source documentation requires restarting payload-processing after a config edit.

The shipped IPP uses parameters and ordered request/response plugin references. Its default profile is chunk-pass-through; the candidate uses only external-metering-streaming on response and does not invent a multi-profile selector.
The selected external-metering-streaming plugin supports both reassembled nonstreaming JSON and SSE in source; a single chunk profile therefore does not require an invented stream/full-body picker.
